The depth is $z = (\mathbf{N}_k \mathbf{p})_4$ [S1].

The claim states that the depth is $z = ( mathbf{N}_k  mathbf{p})_4$. The evidence in Source [S1] explicitly states: 'We remind that the accurate window space depth value is simply the fourth component coming from the previous matrix product.' The 'previous matrix product' refers to the multiplication involving the matrix $ mathbf{N}_k$ (defined as the inverse mapping matrix) and the point coordinates (implied by the context of splat rasterization where $ mathbf{p}$ represents the point). Thus, the fourth component of the product $ mathbf{N}_k  mathbf{p}$ corresponds to the depth $z$.
